verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat is documented as searching across your meetings and connected apps to answer questions (otter-docs-1), and as finding insights from past calls in natural language (otter-docs-11). The MCP blog adds cross-meeting search across all time periods and pattern analysis (otter-docs-18, otter-docs-34). missing for 10: documentation that answers cite or link back to source meetings/transcript passages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-history Q&A quality.
